features.title: ESP-Claw-shaped runtime (caps, events, memory, local agent)
features.esp_claw: claw_cap / claw_event_router / claw_memory / claw_core (inspired, not copied)
features.notes: Pico subset: JSON-ish cap calls, RAM notes, keyword agent, USB claw> REPL. Not full ESP-Claw.

features.title: Claw scheduler
features.backend: FreeRTOS software timers posting claw events
features.notes: Periodic jobs only; no cron expressions

features.title: On-device MCP (capabilities as tools)
features.notes: initialize / tools/list / tools/call / ping. Not a full MCP SDK.

features.title: On-device Lua
features.notes: Pico W cannot host ESP-Claw's Lua + driver set. Event rules substitute for now.

features.title: Instant messaging channels
features.backend: CYW43439 + lwIP + TLS (not an ESP-IDF wifi component)
features.notes: Telegram/Feishu/etc. need the Pico SDK wireless stack. USB REPL is the local stand-in.

features.title: Cloud / HTTP LLM agent path
features.backend: lwIP + mbedTLS HTTP to a user endpoint in sdkconfig
features.notes: Blocked on a Pico Wi-Fi + TLS client, not on an ESP-IDF feature row. Local keyword agent works offline.

features.title: Skills / board manager / HTTP settings UI
features.backend: LittleFS + a small HTTP server later
features.notes: ESP-Claw wants FATFS SYSTEM/DATA partitions; Pico will use LittleFS.
